rows.grounds: accusative singular masculine pronoun referring to the hidden true nature
compound of gūḍha and sadbhāva in accusative singular masculine
abstract noun from sarvajña in nominative singular neuter
middle voice present third singular of pra-jan (to be born or arise)

items.question: What arises when one knows the hidden true nature?
premises: knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature gives rise to omniscience.
uncertainties: the exact referent of taṃ depends on the preceding verse
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
